quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.title: The Beat Underfoot
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.summary: The sky key pulses toward the ground. Something lies beneath the capital.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.done: "The anchor is still loose. ...The sixth verse is a song of the sky."
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.rumor.journal: Now and then the sky key turns downward and pulses. The storyteller may know something.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.rumor.talk: Ask the storyteller about the pulsing key
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.rumor.lead: Storyteller: "That key points down. ...There is a sound from under the capital."
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.prepare.journa: The storyteller said: "The one who came before set the key in a cradle of black iron." Ask at the smithy about the black iron.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.prepare.ready: Ready the black iron cradle at the smithy
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.door.journal: The key rests in its cradle. Deep in the Deep Cup tavern's cellar, before the sealed door, it pulses strongest.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.door.open: Open the cellar's sealed door with the key
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.door.lead: From behind the sealed door comes a beat in time with the key.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.shaft.journal: Beyond the door, a great shaft runs straight down beneath the capital. Light only at the landings. Go down to the bottom.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.shaft.reach: Descend the shaft to the threshold
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.report.journal: The heart of the abyss is the anchor that holds the world in place. Tell the storyteller about the loosened anchor and the nearing moon.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.gate.journal: Beyond the gate at the threshold, a heartbeat sounded. The sky key pulsed in answer and the bars melted away. Pass through the gate into the abyss.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.descend.journa: Four layers behind you. Past the chain in the hall of the ash lord lies the antechamber of the heart. The warden will use everything the layer lords taught: light, weight, the beat and the dark.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.warden.journal:
The heart room is pitch dark. Somewhere in it is a warden you cannot see.
Pass the flame to the ring of lanterns: only in their light does the warden take shape. In the dark, your blows barely reach it.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.heart.journal: The warden melted into the dark. On the altar in the middle, something pulses.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.heart.touch: Touch the heart on the altar
quest.skyabyss.ch5.black_iron.title: A Cradle of Black Iron
quest.skyabyss.ch5.black_iron.summary: For the vessel that holds the key, gather the fire and stone to forge black iron.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.black_iron.done: "The cradle's done. ...Take this template too. The you from before copied the same one."
quest.skyabyss.ch5.black_iron.iron.journ:
The smith said: 'Black iron is forged only with fire from the Ash Wastes. Stoke the forge with blaze rods and melt obsidian into it.'
Three blaze rods and two obsidian are on the capital tool shop's shelf (carried in from the burnt forts of the Ash Wastes).
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.prepare.lead: Smith: "Black iron, huh. ...That needs the fire of the Ash Wastes."
quest.skyabyss.ch5.black_iron.show.journ: The blaze rods and obsidian are ready. Show them to the smith.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.black_iron.show.talk: Show the rods and obsidian to the smith
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch5_rumor:
That key turns downward now and then, doesn't it. ...I noticed too.
At night, when the capital is quiet, there's a sound from under our feet. Not the bell. Something slower.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch5_rumor2:
There's a door in the back of the tavern cellar that won't open. It has been sealed since my grandmother's grandmother's day.
The one who came before... set the key in a cradle of black iron and stood before that door, they say.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch5_rumor3: Ask at the smithy about the black iron. That one doesn't talk much, but goes on and on about the Ash Wastes.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch5_report:
The heart is an anchor... I see. That's why the capital never fell.
The fifth verse. "Breathing, the bottom of the earth." What was breathing was the heart down there.

Four returned, and still not enough. ...The moon is near, you say. The sixth verse is a song of the sky. Even I have never heard it to the end.
The gate stays open. The traces of the yous before are still asleep at the bottom. Dive again whenever you want to look.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_smith.ch5_ir:
A cradle for the key? ...Only black iron will hold. And black iron can only be forged with the fire of the Ash Wastes.
Three blaze rods to fire the forge, two obsidian melted into it. That's enough for the cradle.
The tool shop stocks both blaze rods and obsidian. Goods from the burnt forts of the Ash Wastes. ...If you needn't fetch them yourself, so much the better.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_smith.menu.c: Show the blaze rods and obsidian
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_smith.ch5_ir:
...Good fire. Well done bringing it back.
I've forged the cradle. Put the key here. ...There, a perfect fit. I feel like I've forged one this shape before.
And take this template. A copy of the one that reforges diamond gear into black iron. ...The you from before copied the same one.
message.skyabyss.ch5.door_locked: The door does not move. ...The key's pulse is still faint.
message.skyabyss.ch5.door_open: In time with the key's pulse, the sealed door hums low and opens.
message.skyabyss.ch5.landing_workshop: The ash folk's workshop. ...So this is where they carried the beat.
message.skyabyss.ch5.landing_camp: A camp's remains. The fire almost feels warm. The writing in the notebook looks like yours.
message.skyabyss.ch5.threshold: The threshold. Beyond the barred gate, one distant beat sounds.
message.skyabyss.ch5.gate_locked: The bars of the gate do not move. ...If only you had the sky key.
message.skyabyss.ch5.gate_open: Answering the key's pulse, the bars melt away without a sound. Beyond lies a dark with no bottom.
message.skyabyss.abyss.rest: A lantern rest. ...Fall below, and the light will call you back here.
message.skyabyss.abyss.woke_at_rest: You wake beside the lantern's flame.
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.bone_1: A carving: "We all made it this far. Three lights."
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.bone_2: A carving: "We crossed the bone bridge. Someone said not to look down. I think it was me."
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.bone_3: A carving: "The whale's beat still sounds inside the walls. We returned it, didn't we."
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.bone_4: A carving: "The first light went out. I won't write the name. If I do, I feel we'll meet again."
message.skyabyss.abyss.grave.bone_1: A grave of one before. The name tag is worn away. They sleep with a bone shard in hand.
message.skyabyss.abyss.grave.bone_2: A grave of one before. The tag only says "the seventh time". Beside it, an empty lamp.
message.skyabyss.abyss.grave.bone_3: A grave of one before. A scrap of notebook is wedged under the stone. "Tell the one waiting above I'm sorry."
lore.skyabyss.ch5.carvings_bone.title: Carvings of Those Before (Bone Layer)
lore.skyabyss.ch5.carvings_bone.body:
Four carvings in your own hand on the walls of the Bone layer, top to bottom.

"We all made it this far. Three lights."

"We crossed the bone bridge. Someone said not to look down. I think it was me."

"The whale's beat still sounds inside the walls. We returned it, didn't we."

"The first light went out. I won't write the name. If I do, I feel we'll meet again."
lore.skyabyss.ch5.graves_bone.title: Graves of Those Before (Bone Layer)
lore.skyabyss.ch5.graves_bone.body:
Three graves of those before, found in the Bone layer.

The name tag is worn away. They sleep with a bone shard in hand.

The tag only says "the seventh time". Beside it, an empty lamp.

A scrap of notebook is wedged under the stone. "Tell the one waiting above I'm sorry."
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.salt_1: A carving: "Waiting for the tide to ebb. I'm good at waiting. I've done it many times."
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.salt_2: A carving: "My body feels light. Light enough that I start to think I could climb back up."
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.salt_3: A carving: "Salt had covered last year's writing. Mine. It said the same thing."
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.salt_4: A carving: "The second light went back up. If anyone can return, that is enough."
message.skyabyss.abyss.grave.salt_1: A grave of one before. Covered in salt, only the shape remains. The face is turned upward.
message.skyabyss.abyss.grave.salt_2: A grave of one before. The tag bears your own name. Only the date is different.
message.skyabyss.abyss.grave.salt_3: A grave of one before. Three shells are laid in a row. Someone left them here later.
lore.skyabyss.ch5.carvings_salt.title: Carvings of Those Before (Salt Layer)
lore.skyabyss.ch5.carvings_salt.body:
Four carvings in your own hand on the walls of the Salt layer, top to bottom.

"Waiting for the tide to ebb. I'm good at waiting. I've done it many times."

"My body feels light. Light enough that I start to think I could climb back up."

"Salt had covered last year's writing. Mine. It said the same thing."

"The second light went back up. If anyone can return, that is enough."
lore.skyabyss.ch5.graves_salt.title: Graves of Those Before (Salt Layer)
lore.skyabyss.ch5.graves_salt.body:
Three graves of those before, found in the Salt layer.

Covered in salt, only the shape remains. The face is turned upward.

The tag bears your own name. Only the date is different.

Three shells are laid in a row. Someone left them here later.
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.storm_1: A carving: "Counting the thunder. One, two, three. The same pace as a heart."
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.storm_2: A carving: "Keep to the beat and you can cross. Lose it, and this is your grave."
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.storm_3: A carving: "The wing's beat was gentle. I only understood it here."
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.storm_4: A carving: "Only I am left. There is still one light."
message.skyabyss.abyss.grave.storm_1: A grave of one before. A scorched cloak. The fingers are bent, as if counting beats.
message.skyabyss.abyss.grave.storm_2: A grave of one before. The tag has melted in the lightning. Only a copper ring remains.
message.skyabyss.abyss.grave.storm_3: A grave of one before. "I'll wait here. Wake me when the next me arrives."
lore.skyabyss.ch5.carvings_storm.title: Carvings of Those Before (Storm Layer)
lore.skyabyss.ch5.carvings_storm.body:
Four carvings in your own hand on the walls of the Storm layer, top to bottom.

"Counting the thunder. One, two, three. The same pace as a heart."

"Keep to the beat and you can cross. Lose it, and this is your grave."

"The wing's beat was gentle. I only understood it here."

"Only I am left. There is still one light."
lore.skyabyss.ch5.graves_storm.title: Graves of Those Before (Storm Layer)
lore.skyabyss.ch5.graves_storm.body:
Three graves of those before, found in the Storm layer.

A scorched cloak. The fingers are bent, as if counting beats.

The tag has melted in the lightning. Only a copper ring remains.

"I'll wait here. Wake me when the next me arrives."
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.ash_1: A carving: "It's dark. When I light the lamp, I feel watched. When I don't, more so."
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.ash_2: A carving: "Footsteps follow. They stop when I stop. They walk the way I do."
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.ash_3: A carving: "There is a warden at the bottom. I heard its voice. It was my voice."
message.skyabyss.abyss.carve.ash_4: A carving: "To you who come next. Light all of them. I could only light three."
message.skyabyss.abyss.grave.ash_1: A grave of one before. Finger marks in the ash. They were searching for a light to the end.
message.skyabyss.abyss.grave.ash_2: A grave of one before. The tag is blank. They came here before writing a name.
message.skyabyss.abyss.grave.ash_3: A grave of one before. A heart is carved on the back of the stone. It almost seems to beat.
lore.skyabyss.ch5.carvings_ash.title: Carvings of Those Before (Ash Layer)
lore.skyabyss.ch5.carvings_ash.body:
Four carvings in your own hand on the walls of the Ash layer, top to bottom.

"It's dark. When I light the lamp, I feel watched. When I don't, more so."

"Footsteps follow. They stop when I stop. They walk the way I do."

"There is a warden at the bottom. I heard its voice. It was my voice."

"To you who come next. Light all of them. I could only light three."
lore.skyabyss.ch5.graves_ash.title: Graves of Those Before (Ash Layer)
lore.skyabyss.ch5.graves_ash.body:
Three graves of those before, found in the Ash layer.

Finger marks in the ash. They were searching for a light to the end.

The tag is blank. They came here before writing a name.

A heart is carved on the back of the stone. It almost seems to beat.
message.skyabyss.abyss.shortcut_closed: The winch chain is tangled above. ...Turning it from here might free it.
message.skyabyss.abyss.shortcut_open: The chain comes free, one line up to the rest above.
message.skyabyss.abyss.shortcut_up: You wind the chain up to the rest above.
message.skyabyss.abyss.shortcut_down: You ride the chain down to the rest below.
message.skyabyss.abyss.shortcut_top_clos: A chain anchor. If the winch below is turned, the chain should reach here.
message.skyabyss.abyss.exit: You grip the chain and are drawn upward.
message.skyabyss.abyss.heart_1: You touch the heart on the altar. ...Cold. Yet it is surely beating.
message.skyabyss.abyss.heart_2: You can feel the beat rooting into the whole world underfoot. It is a heart, and an anchor. The anchor that holds the world in place.
message.skyabyss.abyss.heart_3: Lending its beat to the four titans loosened the anchor. Even with them returned, it is not enough. ...Up in the sky, the moon is a little closer.
message.skyabyss.abyss.voice_full: Something in the dark seemed to call your name. ...Light, now.
message.skyabyss.abyss.voice_dark: Stay in the dark and the abyss voice rises; when it fills, your sight goes dark. It quiets near light.
message.skyabyss.warden.lighting: Passing the flame to the lantern... stay close.
message.skyabyss.warden.wake: Something opened its eyes in the dark. Light the lanterns and catch it in the glow.
message.skyabyss.warden.shades: The warden's shadow splits. Only the real one has a heartbeat.
message.skyabyss.warden.wave: The heart's altar tolls three times. Every light goes out.
message.skyabyss.warden.fall: The warden melts into the dark. Something pulses on the altar.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.shaft_landings.title: Crates on the Landings
quest.skyabyss.ch5.shaft_landings.summar: Check whether the crates the excavation party left on the shaft landings are still there.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.shaft_landings.done: "Every crate in the ledger was there. ...There was just no one left to come back for them."
quest.skyabyss.ch5.shaft_landings.worksh:
The storage ledger still lists two of the excavation party's crates: "the ash folk's workshop" and "the camp". Both are landings in the great shaft.
Start with the upper landing.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.shaft_landings.camp.j:
In a corner of the workshop stood a crate with the ledger's mark. Rope and wedges inside.
The other was left at the camp on the lower landing.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.shaft_landings.tell.j:
The camp crate still held dry bread and oil, the seal unbroken.
Let the storage keeper know.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.shaft_landings.tell.t: Tell the storage keeper about the crates
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_storage_keep:
I hear the door under the tavern is open. ...There are lines in my ledger I have never been able to strike out.
Crates the excavation party left when they went down the great shaft, ten years or so ago. Two landings, it says.

No one ever came back for them. Are they still there, or did someone carry them further down?
If you're going down anyway, would you take a look?

The seals unbroken... I see.
I'll leave those lines in the ledger. I'll strike them when someone comes home. Take these for light.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.party_rations.title: Rations for the Party
quest.skyabyss.ch5.party_rations.summary: Carry bread from the innkeeper to the bone camp in the abyss, as the inn once did for the excavation party.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.party_rations.done: "She's alive. ...I'll bake the next batch, then."
quest.skyabyss.ch5.party_rations.pack.jo:
The innkeeper said: whenever an expedition went down, the inn sent bread with them. The last delivery never went out.
Gather 12 loaves. Bread is sold at inns and tool shops.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.party_rations.deliver: The bread is ready. A survivor of the party should be at the camp in the bone layer of the abyss. Take it to her.
Bring the bread to the lamp keeper at the bone camp
quest.skyabyss.ch5.party_rations.tell.jo:
Mio the lamp keeper ate half the bread and wrapped the rest, saying it was the captain's share.
Tell the innkeeper.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.party_rations.tell.ta: Tell the innkeeper it was delivered
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_innkeeper.ch:
Going down, are you. ...That party slept here too, and went down in the morning.
Every time, I sent our bread with them. Only the last batch never went.

Take twelve loaves down, would you. In case anyone is still below.
...If no one is, eat them yourself.

The lamp keeper girl... I see. Saved the captain's share, did she.
I'll bake the next batch. Let me know when you go down.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_survivor_bon: Bread from the Bell Inn... I remember this smell. It was always fresh the morning we went down.
I'll take half. The rest is the captain's share. ...If only I could take it to him.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.gate_sweep.title: Below the Gate
quest.skyabyss.ch5.gate_sweep.summary: Thin out fifteen bone pickers, rib guards or bone flutes in the bone layer of the abyss. Party members count too.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.gate_sweep.done: "That should quiet the noise below the gate a little."
quest.skyabyss.ch5.gate_sweep.sweep.jour:
The Whale Chasers' clerk said that since the gate opened, bones rattle at the bottom of the shaft at night. The excavation party also cleared a path through the bone layer first.
Thin out the bone pickers, rib guards and bone flutes in the bone layer below the gate. Hit rib guards from the side, not into the shield.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.gate_sweep.sweep.kill: Defeat bone pickers, rib guards and bone flutes
quest.skyabyss.ch5.gate_sweep.tell.journ: The rattle in the bone layer has faded a little. Report to the Whale Chasers' Guild.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.gate_sweep.tell.talk: Report to the Whale Chasers' clerk
About the noise at the bottom of the shaft

Since the gate opened, we've had complaints of bones rattling under the tavern floor at night.
The excavation party's records say the layer below the gate is all bone, and they cleared their path there first.
Officially, from the Whale Chasers' Guild: please thin them out in the bone layer, fifteen or so. We'll pay in the anchor iron the party left behind.

Confirmed. I can file away the complaints now.
Here is the anchor iron. ...I'll record it in the guild ledger under the excavation party's name.
quest.skyabyss.daily_abyss_rounds.title: Rounds in the Abyss
quest.skyabyss.daily_abyss_rounds.summar: Defeat twelve foes in the layers of the abyss. Party members count too.
quest.skyabyss.daily_abyss_rounds.done: The tavern floor should be quiet tonight.
quest.skyabyss.daily_abyss_rounds.rounds: A note on the board, with the Whale Chasers' seal: "Patrol the layers of the abyss and thin out twelve or so of what crawls upward. Any layer will do."
quest.skyabyss.daily_abyss_rounds.unlock: Available once you have passed the abyss gate
quest.skyabyss.weekly_abyss_haul.title: A Haul from the Abyss
quest.skyabyss.weekly_abyss_haul.summary: Deliver 8 bone chips and 6 salt crystals, dropped by foes of the bone and salt layers, to the board.
quest.skyabyss.weekly_abyss_haul.done: The haul is in the Whale Chasers' storehouse.
quest.skyabyss.weekly_abyss_haul.haul.jo: A note on the board, in the storage keeper's hand: "Carry abyss goods up, as the excavation party used to. Eight bone chips, six salt crystals. Once every seven days is enough."
quest.skyabyss.weekly_abyss_haul.unlock_: Available once you have passed the abyss gate
